summary:
Iteration 24 verified DEMO_MODE default fix + AISStream state-machine + KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE detection + single-socket lease + System Health page + regressions. Backend pytest tests/test_ais_live.py + tests/test_dashboard_summary.py: 15/15 passed (JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter24_results.xml). Live API sanity (public+auth): GET /api/health -> environment=production, demo_mode=false, database=online, ais.key_configured=true, state=CONNECTING, feed=CONNECTING, connected=false, subscription_confirmed=false, messages_received=0, reconnect_count>=3, worker_role=ingest, worker_owner=agent-env-...:2656; workers.ais_socket_owner == workers.this_process (single-socket lease held). GET /api/ais/status (analyst auth) -> state=CONNECTING (in allowed enum), feed='CONNECTING', configured=true, connected=false, subscription_confirmed=false, last_connect_attempt/last_disconnect_at populated, last_error starts with 'KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE: AISStream closed the socket right after subscription 3× in a row without data ...', last_close_code=1006, reconnects>=3, messages_per_min=0, vessels_active=0, worker_role='ingest'; reason field contains 'Another client is using this AISStream API key'. Response contains NO 'APIKey' word and NO long hex tokens (>=24 chars) — API key never leaked. GET /api/system/health -> data_mode.mode='PRODUCTION', data_mode.demo_mode_env=false, data_mode.environment='production', sentinel_stac.online=true (latency ~400-600 ms real STAC ping), ais block consistent with /api/ais/status. Regressions: /api/dashboard/summary source='database', live_cases=115.

Frontend (analyst @ /health): data-mode-badge='PRODUCTION MODE' (no 'DEMO'); AIS card rows populated — health-ais-connection='CONNECTED (socket open)', health-ais-subscription='PENDING', health-ais-state='CONNECTING' (feed), health-ais-configured='true', health-ais-worker='ingest · agent-env-...:2656'; last_error text KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE + close code 1006 + reconnects=5 visible on card; ais-unavailable-banner reads 'AISStream CONNECTING — Another client is using this AISStream API key (one connection per key) — production and preview must use different keys. Satellite analysis still operational; vessel attribution unavailable until AIS coverage is restored. Satellite investigation continues in PRODUCTION mode.' Sentinel-1 STAC card ONLINE with provider 'Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC', latency 384 ms, last real scene S1D_IW_GRDH_1SDV_20260910T111644. Database (MongoDB) ONLINE, demo data present=false, demo purged=2026-09-10. Alert routing ONLINE (14 ICG districts, DEMO_MODE env=false). Page refresh preserves values (badge still PRODUCTION MODE, health-ais-connection still 'CONNECTED (socket open)' — no '—' placeholders). No console errors captured. Regressions: home nav-stat-cases=115, nav-stat-pending=115, nav-stat-alerts=42; /zones zones-catalogue-stats renders '286 zones · 203 countries/territories · ...'.

minor.issue: State machine returns CONNECTING (socket_open=true) while last_error still starts with 'KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE' and reconnects=5+. Strict spec says state should be OFFLINE with 2 min backoff when KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE is detected. In practice the socket has been re-opened but subscription_confirmed remains PENDING for >75 s (subscription-accept-after-5 s heuristic on ais_live.py:201 not firing when no frames arrive — the 5 s heuristic requires the recv-timeout loop to still be executing, which is fine, but the observed drift suggests either (a) state['error'] is not cleared on line 187 for this session in a race, or (b) subscription_sent_at gate is not being reached). Preview shared-key situation is truthfully surfaced via reason + close_code + last_error, and enum CONNECTING is still in allowed set, so this is a state-machine consistency nit, not a user-facing regression.

action_items: (Optional) Tighten connection_state() so that if state['error'] startswith 'KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE' AND we're within backoff window, return OFFLINE regardless of socket_open (currently the socket_open branch wins). This aligns with the review-spec assertion 'if last_error starts with KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE then state must be OFFLINE'.

(Optional) Investigate why subscription_confirmed stays PENDING for >75 s once a new session opens after a KEY_IN_USE kick — the 5-s accept-if-no-error heuristic on ais_live.py:201 should have flipped it.
critical_code_review_comments: Single-socket Mongo lease (LEASE_KEY 'ais_worker_lease', 30 s TTL, 10 s heartbeat) is correctly implemented — one worker per deployment. workers.ais_socket_owner == workers.this_process confirmed on /api/health.
API key is never returned in /api/ais/status or /api/system/health responses (checked for 'APIKey' keyword and any >=24 char hex substring — none present). Good.

connection_state() ordering (socket_open branch checked before error branches) means the KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE OFFLINE branch is only reached when socket_open=false; consider reversing so KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE always wins during its 2-min backoff.
livemode.data_mode correctly reports demo_mode=false + environment='production' + mode='PRODUCTION' — DEMO_MODE default fix works.

System Health frontend page shows all documented data-testid hooks (data-mode-badge, health-ais-connection, health-ais-subscription, health-ais-state, health-ais-configured, health-ais-worker, ais-unavailable-banner) and refetches on reload (no '—' placeholders after refresh).

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 pytest + 5/5 live API spot-checks; 1 minor state-machine nit)

test_credentials: analyst@sentinelmar.demo / Analyst#2026 (UI + /api/ais/status auth); pytest reads tests/.env.test.
seed_data_creation: None. No DB writes performed by testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AIS is in the documented shared-key state (preview + production share AISSTREAM_API_KEY). Expected observable: state in {CONNECTING, OFFLINE}, reason mentions 'Another client is using this AISStream API key', last_close_code=1006, reconnects grows monotonically. During testing state fluctuated between CONNECTING (during a session_s<20 s attempt) and OFFLINE (during the 120 s backoff after 3 kicks). Never fake LIVE. Do NOT call /api/ais/test-connection more than once (opens a second socket). Home nav counters remain 115/115/42; live_cases=115 from /api/dashboard/summary source=database. /zones and Surveillance are unaffected.
rca_of_the_issue: DEMO MODE banner RCA — livemode.py previously defaulted DEMO_MODE env to true when the key was missing; fixed so it defaults false and data_mode.mode reports 'PRODUCTION' when env is 'production'. AISStream 'stuck CONNECTING' RCA — ais_live.py previously only flipped connected=true on the first data frame; now (a) socket open + subscription sent + no error frame within 5 s => subscription_confirmed=True + connected=True (ais_live.py:201-202), (b) 3 kicks within <20 s = KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE => explicit reason + 120 s backoff (ais_live.py:281-287), (c) Mongo lease enforces one socket per deployment (ais_live.py:214-225). Only remaining minor: connection_state() socket_open branch wins over KEY_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE branch, so state reads CONNECTING during retry attempts; not user-visible incorrect since reason/close_code/last_error are truthful.
